author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr. Danielle Gagne explores how curiosity can transform the way we see cemeteries: from places of endings into open-air museums filled with art, symbolism, and untold human stories. Through the study of gravestones and their hidden meanings, we uncover history, memory, and connection in everyday landscapes. It is an invitation to slow down, ask questions, and rediscover the spark of curiosity that brings the past, and its people, back to life. 

Dr. Danielle Gagne has been a member of the Psychology Division at Alfred University since 2004. What started as a professional opportunity quickly became a true home - as she embraced both the campus and the Alfred community.

In her talk on gravestone symbolism, Dr. Gagne invites us to see cemeteries as “living museums.” Carved images, like clasped hands or broken columns - quietly tell stories of love, loss, faith, and identity. Through these enduring symbols, she reveals how cemeteries preserve a powerful historical record of societal valu
title: The secret language of tombstones | Danielle Gagne | TEDxAlfred University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Most of us know we should exercise more, sleep better, and make healthier choices. So why is it still so hard? Combining personal experience with behavioral science, Dr. Astghik Atanyan explores the gap between knowing and doing, and suggests that what we need is a different kind of relationship with our habits, built on friendship rather than force. Dr. Astghik Atanyan is a medical doctor, public health professional, and a nutritionist.  She serves as a Research Associate at the Avedisian Onanian Center for Health Services Research and Development (CHSR) within the Gerald and Patricia Turpanjian College of Health Sciences at the AUA, where she contributes to a range of public health research and development initiatives. 
In addition, Dr. Atanyan is a Research Assistant Professor at AUA, where she teaches the PH101: Basics of Healthy Lifestyle course. 
Alongside her academic responsibilities, she provides guidance to individuals seeking to improve their nutrition and foster sustainabl
title: Why Knowing What’s Healthy isn’t Enough for Behavior Change  | Astghik Atanyan | TEDxAUA

author: TEDx Talks
description: From a small village in China to architecture, photography, and art, Haibo Xiao shares how he abandoned a future designed by others and began creating one of his own. His journey shows that uncertainty can become the beginning of self-discovery. Haibo Xiao is a multidisciplinary artist, photographer, and founder of HAIPI STUDIO and LEAZÓN. A graduate of The Bartlett at University College London, his work spans sustainable installations, photography, and art therapy. In his talk, “Design Your Own Future,” Mr. Xiao reflects on leaving architecture to pursue a more authentic creative path, encouraging audiences to design lives guided by purpose rather than expectation. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Design Your Own Future | Haibo Xiao | TEDxShanghai Singapore Intl School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Alaattin Kaçar, küçük bir köyden başarılı bir hekimliğe uzanan yolculuğunun ötesinde, insanın kendine yapabileceği en değerli yatırımın tutkularına ve meraklarına zaman ayırmak olduğunu anlatıyor. Kadın Hastalıkları ve Doğum Uzmanı olan Dr. Alaattin Kaçar, tıp eğitimini Ege Üniversitesi’nde tamamladıktan sonra ihtisasını Ege Doğumevi ve Kadın Hastalıkları Eğitim Hastanesi’nde tamamladı. Perinatoloji ve endoskopik cerrahi alanlarına özel ilgi duyan Kaçar, Balıkesir’de çalışmalarını sürdürüyor. Cerrahi alandaki kongreleri ve makaleleri yakından takip eden Alaatin Kaçar'ın bir çok makalesi yayımlanmıştır.
Tıp dünyasındaki başarılarının yanı sıra, fotoğrafçılık, karikatür, havacılık (gyrocopter, planör, microlight pilotluğu), tüplü dalış gibi pek çok alanda üretkenliğiyle dikkat çeken Kaçar, sanatı ve bilimi bir arada yaşatan nadir isimlerden. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted
title: Bir Hayata Kaç Hayat Sığar? | Alaattin Kaçar | TEDxBalikesir Aci Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Mita Wadhwa brings a grassroots perspective to the challenges of building stronger, more inclusive and sustainable communities. Through her work with women, communities and environmental initiatives, she explores how social empowerment and environmental responsibility can come together to create lasting change.
Her talk highlights the power of women and local communities as agents of transformation—from creating livelihood opportunities and strengthening financial independence to taking collective action for cleaner surroundings, better waste management and environmental conservation. Her work with women’s groups and community-led environmental initiatives reflects this intersection of people, planet and participation. Mita Wadhwa is a social worker and community changemaker, and the Founder of SETU Foundation. Her work focuses on women empowerment, livelihood development, sustainability and community well-being, with a strong emphasis on turning social awareness into meaningful actio
title: "Lifestyle is Climate Action". | Mita Wadhwa | TEDxSAGEUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Silence often feels like safety, but it comes at a steep, hidden cost; in both for our personal integrity and our collective progress. In this deeply moving and empowering talk, ROKSANA ANZUMAN NICOLE explores the pivotal moments when speaking up transitions from a personal choice to an absolute necessity.

Drawing from raw personal experience and frontline stories of advocacy, ROKSANA ANZUMAN NICOLE unpacks why breaking the silence is rarely comfortable, yet always transformative. Whether confronting systemic unfairness, asserting personal boundaries, or championing the unheard, this talk offers a grounded roadmap for finding your voice when the stakes are highest, and using it to drive meaningful change.

 Assignment and Planning Edito of the most popular and credible news source of Bangladesh, Jamuna TV. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Raise Your VOICE, Whenever It NEEDS | ROKSANA ANZUMAN NICOLE | TEDxKhulna University

author: TEDx Talks
description: In “Nothing Is Ever Just Waste,” Ashish Sharma explores how changing our perception of discarded materials can open the door to innovation and sustainable solutions. Drawing from the circular-economy approach of transforming coconut waste into useful, biodegradable products, he challenges the conventional “use and throw” mindset. Ashish Sharma is a sustainability and green innovation enthusiast associated with Re-Coco Innovations, working to transform coconut waste into useful, eco-friendly products. His work promotes circular economy, waste upcycling and sustainable living, demonstrating how everyday waste can become a valuable resource. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: "Nothing Is Ever Just Waste". | Ashish Sharma | TEDxSAGEUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if something as ordinary as soap could make us rethink our relationship with nature? In “The Day I Stopped Using Soap,” Devendra Jani, founder of Bee The Lead, shares his personal journey of questioning everyday habits and discovering a deeper connection between human choices, biodiversity and the natural world.
Through an engaging mix of personal experience, storytelling and environmental awareness, the talk explores how seemingly small lifestyle choices can influence ecosystems and the creatures that sustain them. It invites us to look beyond convenience, question what we consider “normal,” and recognise that living sustainably begins with becoming more conscious of our everyday choices.
Core message: Sometimes, changing the way we live begins with simply questioning what we have always taken for granted. Devendra Jani, popularly known as “Mr. Bee of India,” is a bee conservationist, artist and founder of Bee-The Lead. Through his work, he inspires people to look beyond the fea
title: "The Day I Stopped Using Soap". | Devendra Jani | TEDxSAGEUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description: Climate anxiety, ecological grief and the invisible health consequences of a changing planet Dr. Priyanka Pandit is a public health professional working at the intersection of health systems, policy and human well-being. Her work explores how systemic and environmental changes influence health and community resilience. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: "When Home No Longer Feels Like Home". | Dr. Priyanka Pandit | TEDxSAGEUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Nairi Khatchadourian explores the vision of the Araks River becoming a bridge rather than a border. Through architecture and the poetics of relation, she invites us to imagine a future where the river serves as a foundation for dialogue, cooperation, and meaningful connection between Armenia and Iran.
 Nairi Khatchadourian is a Paris-born curator, art historian, and founding director of AHA collective. Since 2019, AHA collective has worked at the intersection of contemporary art, publishing, critical museology, and placemaking, bringing together artists, architects, designers, artisans, and researchers through projects in museums, public spaces, heritage sites, and rural communities.
Khatchadourian has curated more than 30 exhibitions in Armenia and internationally, and has edited numerous publications on Armenian contemporary art, design, and cultural heritage.
Since 2024, AHA collective has operated a gallery in Yerevan, presenting exhibitions and public programs focused on modern a
title: Sharing a River, or the Poetics of Relation | Nairi Khatchadourian | TEDxDebet

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sevagir band performs 2 of their original songs: Ankayun and Falling. Sevagir is an Armenian rock band founded in Yerevan in 2022. With roots in alternative rock filled with progressive elements, and at times leaning towards metal, the band still appeals to fans of indie, alternative, and even rap music. Their music takes listeners through a wide emotional range, from sadness and agony to love and revenge.
These experiences are brought to life through Em Kalmukhyan's expressive vocals, lyrics, and guitar work, supported by the musical backbone of the band, Sahak Ghazaryan and Koryun Bobikyan, forming the rhythm section, and Vahe Karapetyan enriching the instrumentals with the solo guitar.
In just four years, the band has built a substantial fan base, performed over 50 concerts, become a recurring participant in the Erebuni-Yerevan celebrations, released an album and several singles, and gained wide exposure through participation in Depi Evratesil 2025 and the annual Khazer Music Award
title: Musical Performance: Ankayun | Falling | Sevagir Band | TEDxAUA

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if losing wasn't an outcome to avoid, but a skill we could actually train? Drawing from his background in competitive chess and game development, Aram Serobyan reveals how our fear of losing shapes the way we see ourselves and the opportunities we avoid. He shows how games create safe spaces to build that skill, get comfortable with losing, and use it to grow. Aram Serobyan is a game designer and developer focused on educational and commercial games. He holds both a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Computer and Information Science from the American University of Armenia.
Throughout his career, he has worked on different small-scale games with different studios and co-founded an educational gaming startup. He currently leads a small team working on Chesstris, a puzzle game that combines chess and tetris. 
Aram has taught game development at TUMO and, since Spring 2023, has been teaching as an Adjunct Lecturer in the CSE program at AUA, where he shares practical game design and de
title: How games teach you to be a better loser | Aram Serobyan | TEDxAUA

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Most of us leave school believing math is about finding the right answer. But what if its real purpose is teaching us how to deal with questions that don't have one? Drawing on experiences from both sides of the classroom, Meline Afrikyan shares how learning to sit with uncertainty transformed her approach to life. Meline Afrikyan is a senior Computer Science student at the American University of Armenia and an iOS developer with a passion for mathematics, history, and education. Alongside her work in technology, she teaches mathematics, where she enjoys helping students discover the patterns and ideas behind the subject.
She is particularly interested in how analytical thinking, historical perspective, and curiosity shape the way we understand complex problems. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: What math taught me about uncertainty | Meline Afrikyan | TEDxAUA

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if a career isn't meant to follow a straight line, but a series of unexpected opportunities and pivots? Dr. Michael Kouchakdjian reflects on his career shaped by continuous transitions, from biotechnology to entrepreneurship, company acquisition, and later academic and investment leadership. He explores what it takes to let go of certainty at every turn, and how risk, timing, and mindset shape the way we navigate change. Dr. Michael Kouchakdjian is Professor in the College of Business and Economics at the American University of Armenia, where he teaches courses in business, management, and entrepreneurship.
He has a background in the biotechnology industry and is the founder and former president of Blue Stream Laboratories in Cambridge, Massachusetts which was acquired by a large multinational in 2016. At AUA, he has held several senior leadership roles, including Director of Administration, Director of the Center for Business Research and Development, and Project Executive for t
title: How to Succeed When Opportunity Changes Your Career Plans | Michael Kouchakdjian | TEDxAUA

author: TEDx Talks
description: Pamela argues that our world is leaving vast oceans of human potential unexplored, especially when it comes to girls and women in sport. She asks what happens when half the world is prepared to be perfect, while the other half is trained to be brave. From the helm of a high performance offshore racing yacht, where there is no men’s or women’s category and the sea only rewards skill and endurance. She explores how sport can be one of the most powerful engines of human potential. It builds courage, decision making, resilience, and leadership – yet most girls are never given the same structure, investment, or belief as boys. The talk connects big picture themes of equality, representation, and social change with Pamela’s lived experience: an equal childhood, unequal systems, and a career breaking records in one of the most male dominated arenas on earth. It is a call to use sport as a platform for empowerment and to stop treating women’s potential like the deep ocean: acknowledged, but u
title: Ocean of potential, a sea of possibilities | Pamela Lee | TEDxSt Helier

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Confidence. Expression. Freedom. In this high-energy voguing performance, LeosDances and Horseontherunway celebrate individuality, challenge gender stereotypes, and bring the empowering spirit of ballroom culture to the TEDx stage with "Slay Your Life!" by RAGE! Choreo by LeosDances. LeosDances is a viennese dancer and choreographer mainly in the styles such as Commercial, Voguing, Waacking and Heels but who always seeks to try new styles. Leo loves to tell stories and create memorable moments with the art of movement! His creative visions combine confident power with elegant sensuality, breaking gender stereotypes and inspiring others to be truly themselves!

Horseontherunway is a dancer who enjoys all things Vogue and kpop. In their personal time they like to enjoy a variety of video games and dvelve into fantasy worlds. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Performance | LeosDances  & Horseontherunway  | TEDxDonauinsel Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Have you ever rushed into class only to realize you already missed the most important parts of your day?  Valeria explains how chronic tardiness is like missing the first page of your favorite book—you can still follow along, but things quickly get confusing. Sharing research, personal school stories, and actionable morning tips for families, Valeria inspires students and parents to build habits of punctuality that lead to academic success, lower stress, and a stronger sense of responsibility.

This student developed their talk as part of the TED-Ed Student Talk Program in Cajon Valley Union School District. The purpose of TEDxKidsElCajon is to help develop and amplify student voices in our community to empower our youth by creating space for them to share their ideas, bringing awareness to their experiences, and advocating their perspectives. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community.

Learn more at www.tedxki
title: Don’t Miss the First Page | Valeria Sanchez | TEDxKids@ElCajon
